description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Isaiah's vision begins with God's charge against Judah, children who have rebelled. God takes no pleasure in their sacrifices while their hands are full of blood, and calls them to learn to do good and be made clean.
1.sw: Maono ya Isaya yanaanza na mashtaka ya Mungu dhidi ya Yuda, watoto walioasi. Mungu hapendezwi na dhabihu zao wakati mikono yao imejaa damu, na anawaita wajifunze kutenda mema na kutakaswa.
1.am: የኢሳይያስ ራእይ እግዚአብሔር ባመፁ ልጆች፣ በይሁዳ ላይ ባቀረበው ክስ ይጀምራል። እጆቻቸው በደም ተሞልተው ሳሉ እግዚአብሔር በመሥዋዕታቸው ደስ አይለውም፤ መልካም ማድረግን እንዲማሩና እንዲነጹም ይጠራቸዋል።

2.en: In days to come the nations will stream to the mountain of God's house and hammer their swords into plow blades. A day is coming against everything proud, when God alone will be exalted.
2.sw: Katika siku zijazo mataifa yatamiminika kwenda mlimani pa nyumba ya Mungu na kuzifua panga zao kuwa majembe. Siku inakuja dhidi ya kila kitu chenye kiburi, ambapo Mungu peke yake atatukuzwa.
2.am: በሚመጡት ዘመናት ሕዝቦች ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ተራራ ይጐርፋሉ፤ ሰይፎቻቸውንም ቀጥቅጠው የማረሻ ብረት ያደርጓቸዋል። በትዕቢተኛው ነገር ሁሉ ላይ ቀን ይመጣል፤ በዚያም እግዚአብሔር ብቻ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

3.en: God will take away from Jerusalem everything it leans on, and brings a charge against its leaders for crushing the poor. The proud daughters of Zion will lose their finery.
3.sw: Mungu ataondoa kutoka Yerusalemu kila kitu inachokitegemea, na analeta mashtaka dhidi ya viongozi wake kwa kuwaponda maskini. Binti za Sayuni wenye kiburi watapoteza mapambo yao.
3.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌም የምትደገፍበትን ሁሉ ያስወግዳል፤ ድሆችን ስለ ደቈሱም በመሪዎቿ ላይ ክስ ያቀርባል። ትዕቢተኞቹ የጽዮን ቈነጃጅት ጌጣቸውን ያጣሉ።

4.en: Seven women will cling to one man, but the survivors in Zion will be called holy, and God's glory will shelter them.
4.sw: Wanawake saba watamshikilia mwanamume mmoja, lakini waliosalia katika Sayuni wataitwa watakatifu, na utukufu wa Mungu utawafunika.
4.am: ሰባት ሴቶች አንድን ሰው ይይዛሉ፤ በጽዮን የቀሩት ግን ቅዱሳን ተብለው ይጠራሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ይጋርዳቸዋል።

5.en: Isaiah sings of a vineyard that yielded only bad grapes, a picture of Israel and Judah. Woe after woe is pronounced on the greedy and the corrupt, and God's anger has not turned back.
5.sw: Isaya anaimba juu ya shamba la mizabibu lililozaa zabibu mbaya tu, picha ya Israeli na Yuda. Ole baada ya ole inatangazwa juu ya wenye tamaa na wapotovu, na hasira ya Mungu haijarudi nyuma.
5.am: ኢሳይያስ መጥፎ ወይን ብቻ ስላፈራ የወይን ቦታ ይዘምራል፤ ይህም የእስራኤልና የይሁዳ ምስል ነው። በስግብግቦችና በብልሹዎች ላይ ወዮታ በወዮታ ላይ ይታወጃል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ አልተመለሰም።

6.en: In the year King Uzziah dies, Isaiah sees the Lord seated on a throne, with seraphim calling to each other that God is holy. His lips are cleansed, and he is sent to a people who will not understand.
6.sw: Katika mwaka ule mfalme Uzia anapokufa, Isaya anamwona Bwana ameketi juu ya kiti cha enzi, na maserafi wakiitana kwamba Mungu ni mtakatifu. Midomo yake inatakaswa, naye anatumwa kwa watu wasiotaka kuelewa.
6.am: ንጉሥ ዖዝያ በሞተበት ዓመት ኢሳይያስ ጌታን በዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦ ያየዋል፤ ሱራፌልም እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ እንደ ሆነ እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠራራሉ። ከንፈሮቹ ይነጻሉ፤ ወደማያስተውል ሕዝብም ይላካል።

7.en: When Aram and Israel threaten Judah, Isaiah tells Ahaz not to fear these two charred ends of firewood. God offers a sign: the young woman will give birth to a son and call him Immanuel.
7.sw: Aramu na Israeli wanapoitishia Yuda, Isaya anamwambia Ahazi asiogope vipande hivi viwili vya kuni vilivyoungua. Mungu anatoa ishara: msichana atazaa mtoto wa kiume na kumpa jina Imanueli.
7.am: አራምና እስራኤል ይሁዳን ሲያስፈራሩ ኢሳይያስ አካዝን እነዚህን ሁለት የተቃጠሉ የማገዶ ጉማጆች እንዳይፈራ ይነግረዋል። እግዚአብሔር ምልክት ይሰጣል፦ ወጣቷ ሴት ወንድ ልጅ ትወልዳለች፤ ስሙንም አማኑኤል ብላ ትጠራዋለች።

8.en: Isaiah's son is named Maher-shalal-hash-baz as a sign that Assyria will come. The people must fear only God and turn to the instruction and the testimony.
8.sw: Mwana wa Isaya anapewa jina Maher-shalal-hash-bazi kama ishara kwamba Ashuru itakuja. Watu wanapaswa kumwogopa Mungu peke yake na kuyarudia mafundisho na ushuhuda.
8.am: የኢሳይያስ ልጅ አሦር እንደሚመጣ ምልክት ሆኖ ማኄር ሻላል ሐሽ ባዝ ተብሎ ይሰየማል። ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔርን ብቻ ሊፈሩና ወደ ትምህርቱና ወደ ምስክሩ ሊመለሱ ይገባቸዋል።

9.en: The people walking in the dark have seen a great light, for a child is born who will reign on David's throne forever. Yet God's anger against Israel's pride has not turned back.
9.sw: Watu wanaotembea gizani wameona nuru kubwa, kwa maana mtoto amezaliwa atakayetawala juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi milele. Lakini hasira ya Mungu dhidi ya kiburi cha Israeli haijarudi nyuma.
9.am: በጨለማ የሚሄድ ሕዝብ ታላቅ ብርሃን አየ፤ በዳዊት ዙፋን ላይ ለዘላለም የሚነግሥ ልጅ ተወልዷልና። ሆኖም እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ትዕቢት ላይ ያለው ቍጣ አልተመለሰም።

10.en: Woe to those who write unjust laws. Assyria is the rod of God's anger but will itself be judged, and a remnant of Israel will return.
10.sw: Ole wao wanaoandika sheria zisizo za haki. Ashuru ni fimbo ya hasira ya Mungu lakini yenyewe itahukumiwa, na mabaki ya Israeli watarudi.
10.am: ፍትሕ የጐደለው ሕግ ለሚጽፉ ወዮላቸው። አሦር የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በትር ናት፤ እርሷ ራሷ ግን ትፈረድባለች፤ የእስራኤልም ቅሬታ ይመለሳሉ።

11.en: A shoot will come from the stump of Jesse, and the Spirit of God will rest on him; he will judge the poor with justice, and the wolf will live with the lamb. God will gather the scattered people.
11.sw: Chipukizi litaota kutoka kisiki cha Yese, na Roho wa Mungu atakaa juu yake; atawahukumu maskini kwa haki, na mbwa mwitu ataishi pamoja na mwana-kondoo. Mungu atawakusanya watu waliotawanyika.
11.am: ከእሴይ ጉቶ ቀንበጥ ይበቅላል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በእርሱ ላይ ያርፋል፤ ለድሆች በፍትሕ ይፈርዳል፤ ተኵላም ከበግ ጠቦት ጋር ይኖራል። እግዚአብሔር የተበተኑትን ሕዝብ ይሰበስባል።

12.en: On that day the people will sing that God is their salvation and draw water from the wells of salvation.
12.sw: Siku hiyo watu wataimba kwamba Mungu ni wokovu wao na kuteka maji kutoka katika chemchemi za wokovu.
12.am: በዚያ ቀን ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር መዳናቸው እንደ ሆነ ይዘምራሉ፤ ከመዳን ምንጮችም ውኃ ይቀዳሉ።

13.en: Isaiah's oracle against Babylon announces the day of God, when the Medes will overthrow the city.
13.sw: Ujumbe wa Isaya dhidi ya Babeli unatangaza siku ya Mungu, ambapo Wamedi watauangusha mji huo.
13.am: ኢሳይያስ በባቢሎን ላይ ያስተላለፈው ቃል ሜዶናውያን ከተማዪቱን የሚገለብጧትን የእግዚአብሔርን ቀን ያውጃል።

14.en: God will have mercy on Jacob, and Israel will mock the fallen king of Babylon, the shining one, son of Dawn, hewn down to the earth. Assyria will be broken and Philistia is warned.
14.sw: Mungu atamhurumia Yakobo, na Israeli watamdhihaki mfalme wa Babeli aliyeanguka, yule ung'aaye, mwana wa Alfajiri, aliyekatwa na kuangushwa chini. Ashuru itavunjwa na Ufilisti unaonywa.
14.am: እግዚአብሔር ለያዕቆብ ይራራል፤ እስራኤልም የወደቀውን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ፣ ተቈርጦ ወደ ምድር የወደቀውን አንጸባራቂውን የንጋት ልጅ ይሣለቁበታል። አሦር ትሰበራለች፤ ፍልስጥኤምም ይነገራታል።

15.en: Isaiah's oracle laments the destruction of Moab.
15.sw: Ujumbe wa Isaya unaomboleza kuangamizwa kwa Moabu.

16.en: Moab's outcasts seek shelter in Zion, and the prophet weeps for the vine of Sibmah.
16.sw: Watu wa Moabu waliofukuzwa wanatafuta kimbilio Sayuni, na nabii analia kwa ajili ya mzabibu wa Sibma.
16.am: ከሞዓብ የተባረሩት በጽዮን መጠጊያ ይፈልጋሉ፤ ነቢዩም ለሴባማ ወይን ያለቅሳል።

17.en: Damascus and Ephraim will be brought low, and people will look to their Maker. The roaring nations will be driven off like chaff.
17.sw: Dameski na Efraimu watashushwa, na watu watamtazama Muumba wao. Mataifa yanayonguruma yatafukuzwa kama makapi.
17.am: ደማስቆና ኤፍሬም ይዋረዳሉ፤ ሰዎችም ወደ ፈጣሪያቸው ይመለከታሉ። የሚያገሡ ሕዝቦች እንደ ገለባ ይባረራሉ።

18.en: Envoys come from beyond the rivers of Cush, and a gift will be brought to God on Mount Zion.
18.sw: Wajumbe wanakuja kutoka ng'ambo ya mito ya Kushi, na zawadi italetwa kwa Mungu juu ya Mlima Sayuni.
18.am: መልእክተኞች ከኩሽ ወንዞች ማዶ ይመጣሉ፤ በጽዮን ተራራም ለእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ይቀርባል።

19.en: In an oracle against Egypt, its rivers dry up and its counselors fail. Egypt will come to know God, and Egypt, Assyria and Israel will be a blessing in the middle of the earth.
19.sw: Katika ujumbe dhidi ya Misri, mito yake inakauka na washauri wake wanashindwa. Misri itamjua Mungu, na Misri, Ashuru na Israeli watakuwa baraka katikati ya dunia.
19.am: በግብፅ ላይ በተነገረው ቃል ወንዞቿ ይደርቃሉ፤ መካሪዎቿም ይሰናከላሉ። ግብፅ እግዚአብሔርን ታውቃለች፤ ግብፅ፣ አሦርና እስራኤልም በምድር መካከል በረከት ይሆናሉ።

20.en: Isaiah goes naked and barefoot for three years as a sign that Assyria will lead Egypt and Cush away captive.
20.sw: Isaya anatembea uchi na bila viatu kwa miaka mitatu kama ishara kwamba Ashuru itawachukua Misri na Kushi mateka.
20.am: ኢሳይያስ አሦር ግብፅንና ኩሽን ማርካ እንደምትወስድ ምልክት ሆኖ ሦስት ዓመት ራቁቱንና ባዶ እግሩን ይሄዳል።

21.en: A watchman announces that Babylon has fallen. Oracles follow concerning Dumah and Arabia.
21.sw: Mlinzi anatangaza kwamba Babeli imeanguka. Ujumbe unafuata kuhusu Duma na Arabia.
21.am: ጠባቂ ባቢሎን እንደ ወደቀች ያውጃል። ስለ ዱማና ስለ ዓረብ የተነገሩ ቃላት ይከተላሉ።

22.en: Jerusalem feasts when it should mourn, trusting its defenses instead of God. Shebna the steward is removed, and Eliakim is given the key of the house of David.
22.sw: Yerusalemu inafanya karamu wakati inapaswa kuomboleza, ikizitumainia ngome zake badala ya Mungu. Shebna msimamizi anaondolewa, na Eliakimu anapewa ufunguo wa nyumba ya Daudi.
22.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ልታለቅስ በሚገባት ጊዜ ትፈነጥዛለች፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ይልቅ በመከላከያዎቿ ትታመናለች። አስተዳዳሪው ሼብና ይሻራል፤ ለኤልያቄምም የዳዊት ቤት መክፈቻ ይሰጠዋል።

23.en: Isaiah's oracle announces the fall of Tyre, which will be forgotten for seventy years and then restored.
23.sw: Ujumbe wa Isaya unatangaza kuanguka kwa Tiro, utakaosahauliwa kwa miaka sabini kisha urejeshwe.
23.am: የኢሳይያስ ቃል ለሰባ ዓመት ተረስታ ከዚያም የምትታደሰውን የጢሮስን ውድቀት ያውጃል።

24.en: God will lay waste the earth because its people have broken the everlasting covenant. Songs rise from the edge of the earth, and God will reign on Mount Zion.
24.sw: Mungu ataiharibu dunia kwa sababu watu wake wamelivunja agano la milele. Nyimbo zinapanda kutoka miisho ya dunia, na Mungu atatawala juu ya Mlima Sayuni.
24.am: ሕዝቧ የዘላለሙን ቃል ኪዳን ስላፈረሱ እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ባድማ ያደርጋታል። ከምድር ዳርቻ መዝሙሮች ይነሣሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን ተራራ ላይ ይነግሣል።

25.en: The prophet praises God for the fall of the proud city. On the mountain God will prepare a feast for all peoples and swallow up death forever.
25.sw: Nabii anamsifu Mungu kwa kuanguka kwa mji wenye kiburi. Juu ya mlima Mungu ataandaa karamu kwa watu wote na kukimeza kifo milele.
25.am: ነቢዩ ስለ ትዕቢተኛዪቱ ከተማ ውድቀት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናል። በተራራው ላይ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቦች ሁሉ ግብዣ ያዘጋጃል፤ ሞትንም ለዘላለም ይውጣል።

26.en: Judah sings of its strong city and prays for God to act. God's dead will live, and the people are to hide until God's wrath has passed.
26.sw: Yuda inaimba juu ya mji wake wenye nguvu na kuomba Mungu atende. Wafu wa Mungu wataishi, na watu wanapaswa kujificha mpaka ghadhabu ya Mungu ipite.
26.am: ይሁዳ ስለ ብርቱ ከተማዋ ትዘምራለች፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲሠራ ትጸልያለች። የእግዚአብሔር ሙታን በሕይወት ይኖራሉ፤ ሕዝቡም የእግዚአብሔር መዓት እስኪያልፍ ድረስ ሊሸሸጉ ይገባቸዋል።

27.en: God will punish Leviathan, and a new song is sung over the fruitful vineyard of Israel. The scattered people will be gathered one by one to worship in Jerusalem.
27.sw: Mungu atamwadhibu Lewiathani, na wimbo mpya unaimbwa juu ya shamba la mizabibu la Israeli lenye matunda. Watu waliotawanyika watakusanywa mmoja mmoja ili kuabudu Yerusalemu.
27.am: እግዚአብሔር ሌዋታንን ይቀጣል፤ በፍሬያማው የእስራኤል የወይን ቦታ ላይም አዲስ መዝሙር ይዘመራል። የተበተኑት ሕዝብ በኢየሩሳሌም ለመስገድ አንድ በአንድ ይሰበሰባሉ።

28.en: Woe to the fading crown of Ephraim and to drunken priests and prophets. Jerusalem's rulers have made a covenant with death, but God lays a tested stone in Zion.
28.sw: Ole wake taji inayofifia ya Efraimu na makuhani na manabii walevi. Watawala wa Yerusalemu wamefanya agano na kifo, lakini Mungu anaweka katika Sayuni jiwe lililothibitishwa kwa kujaribiwa.
28.am: ለሚጠወልገው የኤፍሬም ዘውድና ለሰካራሞቹ ካህናትና ነቢያት ወዮላቸው። የኢየሩሳሌም ገዦች ከሞት ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ገብተዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን በጽዮን በፈተና የተረጋገጠ ድንጋይ ያኖራል።

29.en: Woe to Ariel, Jerusalem, which will be besieged. The people honor God with their lips while their hearts are far away, and they forget that the potter is not like the clay.
29.sw: Ole wake Arieli, yaani Yerusalemu, utakaozingirwa. Watu wanamheshimu Mungu kwa midomo yao wakati mioyo yao iko mbali, na wanasahau kwamba mfinyanzi si kama udongo.
29.am: ለምትከበበው ለአርኤል፣ ለኢየሩሳሌም ወዮላት። ሕዝቡ ልባቸው ርቆ ሳለ እግዚአብሔርን በከንፈሮቻቸው ያከብራሉ፤ ሸክላ ሠሪው እንደ ጭቃው እንዳልሆነም ይረሳሉ።

30.en: Woe to those who make an alliance with Egypt instead of trusting God, for in coming back and resting they would be rescued. God longs to be gracious to Zion and will come against Assyria.
30.sw: Ole wao wanaofanya mapatano na Misri badala ya kumtumaini Mungu, kwa maana kwa kurudi na kupumzika wangeokolewa. Mungu anatamani kuwa na neema kwa Sayuni na atakuja dhidi ya Ashuru.
30.am: በእግዚአብሔር ከመታመን ይልቅ ከግብፅ ጋር ኅብረት ለሚያደርጉ ወዮላቸው፤ ቢመለሱና ቢያርፉ ይድኑ ነበርና። እግዚአብሔር ለጽዮን ሊራራ ይናፍቃል፤ በአሦርም ላይ ይመጣል።

31.en: Woe to those who rely on horses from Egypt instead of the Holy One of Israel. God will come down to defend Mount Zion.
31.sw: Ole wao wanaotegemea farasi kutoka Misri badala ya Mtakatifu wa Israeli. Mungu atashuka kuulinda Mlima Sayuni.
31.am: ከእስራኤል ቅዱስ ይልቅ በግብፅ ፈረሶች ለሚደገፉ ወዮላቸው። እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ተራራ ለመከላከል ይወርዳል።

32.en: A king will reign in righteousness. The women at ease are warned, until the Spirit is poured out from on high and justice and peace fill the land.
32.sw: Mfalme atatawala kwa haki. Wanawake wanaostarehe wanaonywa, mpaka Roho amwagwe kutoka juu na haki na amani vijaze nchi.
32.am: ንጉሥ በጽድቅ ይነግሣል። ተዝናንተው የሚኖሩ ሴቶች ይመከራሉ፤ መንፈስ ከላይ እስኪፈስስና ፍትሕና ሰላም ምድሪቱን እስኪሞሉ ድረስ።

33.en: Woe to the destroyer. The people pray in distress, and those who walk righteously will see the king in his beauty.
33.sw: Ole wake mharibifu. Watu wanaomba wakiwa katika dhiki, na wale wanaoenenda kwa haki watamwona mfalme katika uzuri wake.
33.am: ለአጥፊው ወዮለት። ሕዝቡ በጭንቅ ውስጥ ሆነው ይጸልያሉ፤ በጽድቅ የሚመላለሱም ንጉሡን በውበቱ ያዩታል።

34.en: God's wrath is poured out on the nations, and Edom is made a desolate wasteland.
34.sw: Ghadhabu ya Mungu inamwagwa juu ya mataifa, na Edomu inafanywa nyika ya ukiwa.
34.am: የእግዚአብሔር መዓት በሕዝቦች ላይ ይፈስሳል፤ ኤዶምም ባድማ ምድረ በዳ ትሆናለች።

35.en: The wilderness will burst into flower, the blind will see and the lame leap, and the redeemed will return to Zion with singing.
35.sw: Jangwa litachanua maua, vipofu wataona na viwete watarukaruka, na waliokombolewa watarudi Sayuni kwa nyimbo.
35.am: ምድረ በዳው ያብባል፤ ዕውሮች ያያሉ፤ አንካሶችም ይዘልላሉ፤ የተዋጁትም በዝማሬ ወደ ጽዮን ይመለሳሉ።

36.en: Sennacherib invades Judah, and his chief officer stands at the walls of Jerusalem mocking Hezekiah's trust in God.
36.sw: Senakeribu anaivamia Yuda, na Rabshake anasimama karibu na kuta za Yerusalemu akidhihaki tumaini la Hezekia kwa Mungu.
36.am: ሰናክሬም ይሁዳን ይወርራል፤ የጦር መሪው ራፋስቂስም በኢየሩሳሌም ቅጥሮች አጠገብ ቆሞ ሕዝቅያስ በእግዚአብሔር መታመኑን ያላግጥበታል።

37.en: Hezekiah sends word to Isaiah and prays, and Isaiah answers that Assyria will not enter the city. An angel strikes the Assyrian camp, and Sennacherib is killed at home.
37.sw: Hezekia anatuma habari kwa Isaya na kuomba, na Isaya anajibu kwamba Ashuru haitauingia mji. Malaika anaipiga kambi ya Ashuru, na Senakeribu anauawa nyumbani kwake.
37.am: ሕዝቅያስ ወደ ኢሳይያስ መልእክት ይልካል፤ ይጸልያልም፤ ኢሳይያስም አሦር ወደ ከተማዪቱ እንደማትገባ ይመልሳል። መልአክ የአሦርን ሰፈር ይመታል፤ ሰናክሬምም በአገሩ ይገደላል።

38.en: Hezekiah is sick and is given fifteen more years, with the shadow on the steps as a sign. He writes a song of thanks after his recovery.
38.sw: Hezekia ni mgonjwa na anaongezewa miaka kumi na mitano, pamoja na kivuli katika ngazi kama ishara. Anaandika wimbo wa shukrani baada ya kupona.
38.am: ሕዝቅያስ ይታመማል፤ በደረጃዎቹ ላይ ያለው ጥላ ምልክት ሆኖ ዐሥራ አምስት ዓመት ይጨመርለታል። ከተፈወሰ በኋላም የምስጋና መዝሙር ይጽፋል።

39.en: Hezekiah shows his treasures to messengers from Babylon, and Isaiah warns that all will be carried off to Babylon.
39.sw: Hezekia anawaonyesha wajumbe kutoka Babeli hazina zake, na Isaya anaonya kwamba vyote vitachukuliwa mpaka Babeli.
39.am: ሕዝቅያስ ከባቢሎን ለመጡ መልእክተኞች ሀብቱን ያሳያቸዋል፤ ኢሳይያስም ሁሉም ወደ ባቢሎን እንደሚወሰድ ያስጠነቅቃል።

40.en: God tells the prophet to comfort God's people, for their hard service is over. No one can measure God, who gives strength to the weary, and those who wait for God will climb high on outspread wings like eagles.
40.sw: Mungu anamwambia nabii awafariji watu wa Mungu, kwa maana utumishi wao mgumu umekwisha. Hakuna awezaye kumpima Mungu, anayewapa nguvu waliochoka, na wale wanaomngojea Mungu watapaa juu kwa mabawa yaliyokunjuliwa kama tai.
40.am: እግዚአብሔር ነቢዩን የእግዚአብሔርን ሕዝብ እንዲያጽናና ይነግረዋል፤ ከባዱ አገልግሎታቸው አብቅቷልና። የደከሙትን የሚያበረታውን እግዚአብሔርን ማንም ሊለካ አይችልም፤ እግዚአብሔርን በተስፋ የሚጠባበቁም ክንፋቸውን ዘርግተው እንደ ንስሮች ከፍ ብለው ይወጣሉ።

41.en: God calls the nations to court and tells Israel, God's servant, not to be afraid. The idols are put on trial and shown to be nothing.
41.sw: Mungu anayaita mataifa mahakamani na kumwambia Israeli, mtumishi wa Mungu, asiogope. Sanamu zinashtakiwa na kuonyeshwa kuwa si kitu.
41.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቦችን ወደ ፍርድ ይጠራል፤ የእግዚአብሔርን አገልጋይ እስራኤልንም እንዳይፈራ ይነግረዋል። ጣዖታት ይፈረድባቸዋል፤ ከንቱ እንደ ሆኑም ይገለጣሉ።

42.en: God's servant will bring justice to the nations gently, not snapping off a split reed. All the earth is to sing a new song, but Israel, God's servant, is blind and deaf.
42.sw: Mtumishi wa Mungu ataleta haki kwa mataifa kwa upole, bila kulivunja tete lililopasuka. Dunia yote inapaswa kuimba wimbo mpya, lakini Israeli, mtumishi wa Mungu, ni kipofu na kiziwi.
42.am: የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ የተጣመመውን ሸምበቆ ሳይቈርጥ በየዋህነት ለሕዝቦች ፍትሕን ያመጣል። ምድር ሁሉ አዲስ መዝሙር ልትዘምር ይገባታል፤ የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ እስራኤል ግን ዕውርና ደንቆሮ ነው።

43.en: God has redeemed Israel and called them by name; they belong to God. God is doing something new, making a way in the wilderness, though Israel has wearied God with their sins.
43.sw: Mungu amewakomboa Israeli na kuwaita kwa jina; wao ni mali ya Mungu. Mungu anafanya jambo jipya, akichonga barabara katikati ya nyika, ingawa Israeli wamemchosha Mungu kwa dhambi zao.
43.am: እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ተቤዥቷቸዋል፤ በስማቸውም ጠርቷቸዋል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ናቸው። እስራኤል በኃጢአታቸው እግዚአብሔርን ቢያደክሙትም እግዚአብሔር በምድረ በዳ መንገድን እየቀደደ አዲስ ነገር ያደርጋል።

44.en: God will pour out water and Spirit on the chosen people. God is the first and the last, idols made of wood are foolish, and the Maker of all things names Cyrus as the one who will rebuild Jerusalem.
44.sw: Mungu atamwaga maji na Roho juu ya watu wake wateule. Mungu ni wa kwanza na wa mwisho, sanamu zilizotengenezwa kwa mbao ni upumbavu, na Muumba wa vitu vyote anamtaja Koreshi kama yule atakayeijenga upya Yerusalemu.
44.am: እግዚአብሔር በመረጣቸው ሕዝብ ላይ ውኃንና መንፈስን ያፈስሳል። እግዚአብሔር ፊተኛውና ኋለኛው ነው፤ ከእንጨት የተሠሩ ጣዖታት ሞኝነት ናቸው፤ የሁሉ ፈጣሪም ኢየሩሳሌምን እንደ ገና የሚሠራው ቂሮስ እንደ ሆነ ይናገራል።

45.en: God calls Cyrus by name to subdue nations for the sake of Israel. The clay does not question the potter, and the ends of the earth are called to turn to God and be saved.
45.sw: Mungu anamwita Koreshi kwa jina ili kuyatiisha mataifa kwa ajili ya Israeli. Udongo haumhoji mfinyanzi, na miisho ya dunia inaitwa kumgeukia Mungu na kuokolewa.
45.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ሲል ሕዝቦችን እንዲያስገዛ ቂሮስን በስሙ ይጠራዋል። ጭቃ ሸክላ ሠሪውን አይጠይቅም፤ የምድር ዳርቻዎችም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሰው እንዲድኑ ይጠራሉ።

46.en: The gods of Babylon must be carried as burdens, but God has carried Israel from birth, and God's plan will stand.
46.sw: Miungu ya Babeli inalazimika kubebwa kama mizigo, lakini Mungu amewabeba Israeli tangu kuzaliwa, na mpango wa Mungu utasimama.
46.am: የባቢሎን አማልክት እንደ ሸክም መሸከም አለባቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን እስራኤልን ከልደታቸው ጀምሮ ተሸክሟቸዋል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ዕቅድ ይጸናል።

47.en: Daughter Babylon is brought down into the dust, and her spells and stargazers cannot save her.
47.sw: Binti Babeli anashushwa mavumbini, na uchawi wake na watazamaji wake wa nyota hawawezi kumwokoa.
47.am: ልጅቷ ባቢሎን ወደ ትቢያ ትወርዳለች፤ አስማቷና ኮከብ ቈጣሪዎቿም ሊያድኗት አይችሉም።

48.en: God foretold these things to a stubborn people so they could not credit their idols. God is the first and the last, and if only they had listened, their peace would have been like a river.
48.sw: Mungu aliyatabiri mambo haya kwa watu wakaidi ili wasiweze kuzipa sanamu zao sifa. Mungu ni wa kwanza na wa mwisho, na laiti wangalisikiliza, amani yao ingalikuwa kama mto.
48.am: እግዚአብሔር ይህን ለአንገተ ደንዳና ሕዝብ አስቀድሞ የተናገረው ጣዖቶቻቸውን እንዳያመሰግኑ ነው። እግዚአብሔር ፊተኛውና ኋለኛው ነው፤ ቢሰሙ ኖሮ ሰላማቸው እንደ ወንዝ በሆነ ነበር።

49.en: The servant, called before birth, will be a light to the nations. In a time of favor God will bring the people home, and God will never forget Zion, as a mother cannot forget her child.
49.sw: Mtumishi, aliyeitwa kabla ya kuzaliwa, atakuwa nuru kwa mataifa. Wakati wa kibali Mungu atawarudisha watu nyumbani, na Mungu hataisahau Sayuni kamwe, kama mama asivyoweza kumsahau mtoto wake.
49.am: ከመወለዱ በፊት የተጠራው አገልጋይ ለሕዝቦች ብርሃን ይሆናል። በሞገስ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ወደ አገራቸው ይመልሳል፤ እናት ልጇን መርሳት እንደማትችል እግዚአብሔርም ጽዮንን ከቶ አይረሳም።

50.en: The people were sold for their sins, not divorced. The servant listens to God each morning and does not turn back from those who strike him.
50.sw: Watu waliuzwa kwa sababu ya dhambi zao, hawakupewa talaka. Mtumishi anamsikiliza Mungu kila asubuhi na harudi nyuma mbele ya wale wanaompiga.
50.am: ሕዝቡ የተሸጡት ስለ ኃጢአታቸው እንጂ አልተፈቱም። አገልጋዩ በየማለዳው እግዚአብሔርን ያደምጣል፤ ከሚመቱትም ፊት ወደ ኋላ አይመለስም።

51.en: The people are told to look to Abraham and Sarah, the rock they were cut from. The arm of God is called to awake, and the cup of wrath is taken from Jerusalem.
51.sw: Watu wanaambiwa wamtazame Abrahamu na Sara, mwamba waliokatwa kutoka kwake. Mkono wa Mungu unaitwa kuamka, na kikombe cha ghadhabu kinaondolewa kutoka Yerusalemu.
51.am: ሕዝቡ ወደ ተቈረጡበት ዓለት፣ ወደ አብርሃምና ወደ ሣራ እንዲመለከቱ ይነገራቸዋል። የእግዚአብሔር ክንድ እንዲነቃ ይጠራል፤ የመዓቱም ጽዋ ከኢየሩሳሌም ይወሰዳል።

52.en: Zion is called to rise from the dust, for God has redeemed Jerusalem, and the feet of the messenger bring good news. The servant will be raised high.
52.sw: Sayuni inaitwa kuinuka kutoka mavumbini, kwa maana Mungu ameikomboa Yerusalemu, na miguu ya mjumbe inaleta habari njema. Mtumishi atainuliwa juu.
52.am: ጽዮን ከትቢያ እንድትነሣ ትጠራለች፤ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ተቤዥቷታልና፤ የመልእክተኛውም እግሮች የምሥራች ያመጣሉ። አገልጋዩ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

53.en: The servant was despised and shunned, wounded for the people's sins and crushed for their wrongdoing, led like a lamb to the slaughter. He bore the sin of many, and God will give him a portion among the great.
53.sw: Mtumishi alidharauliwa na kuepukwa, alitobolewa kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu na kupondwa kwa ajili ya hatia yao, akapelekwa kama mwana-kondoo kuchinjwa. Alibeba dhambi ya wengi, na Mungu atampa sehemu yake kati ya wakuu.
53.am: አገልጋዩ ተናቀ፤ ገሸሽም ተደረገ፤ ስለ ሕዝቡ ኃጢአት ተወጋ፤ ስለ በደላቸውም ተቀጠቀጠ፤ ሊታረድ እንደሚወሰድ ጠቦትም ተወሰደ። የብዙዎችን ኃጢአት ተሸከመ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በታላላቆች መካከል ድርሻ ይሰጠዋል።

54.en: The barren woman is told to sing, for she will have many children. God's promise of peace is as firm as the oath to Noah, and Zion will be built of precious stones.
54.sw: Mwanamke tasa anaambiwa aimbe, kwa maana atakuwa na watoto wengi. Ahadi ya Mungu ya amani ni imara kama kiapo kwa Nuhu, na Sayuni itajengwa kwa mawe ya thamani.
54.am: መካኒቱ ሴት እንድትዘምር ይነገራታል፤ ብዙ ልጆች ይኖሯታልና። እግዚአብሔር የሰጠው የሰላም ተስፋ ለኖኅ እንደ ማለው መሐላ የጸና ነው፤ ጽዮንም በከበሩ ድንጋዮች ትሠራለች።

55.en: All who are thirsty are invited to come and receive food and drink without cost. They are called to seek God while God may be found, for God's word will do what God sends it to do.
55.sw: Wote wenye kiu wanaalikwa waje wapokee chakula na kinywaji bila gharama. Wanaitwa kumtafuta Mungu wakati bado anaweza kupatikana, kwa maana neno la Mungu litatimiza kile Mungu alichokituma kufanya.
55.am: የተጠሙ ሁሉ መጥተው ያለ ዋጋ ምግብና መጠጥ እንዲቀበሉ ይጋበዛሉ። እግዚአብሔር ገና ሊገኝ ሲችል እንዲፈልጉት ይጠራሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የላከውን ይፈጽማልና።

56.en: Foreigners and eunuchs who keep the covenant will be welcomed, for God's house will be a house of prayer for all peoples. Israel's watchmen are blind and its shepherds greedy.
56.sw: Wageni na matowashi wanaolishika agano watakaribishwa, kwa maana nyumba ya Mungu itakuwa nyumba ya maombi kwa ajili ya mataifa yote. Walinzi wa Israeli ni vipofu na wachungaji wake ni walafi.
56.am: ቃል ኪዳኑን የሚጠብቁ እንግዶችና ጃንደረቦች ይቀበላሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቤት ለሕዝቦች ሁሉ የጸሎት ቤት ይሆናልና። የእስራኤል ጠባቂዎች ዕውሮች፣ እረኞቿም ስግብግቦች ናቸው።

57.en: The righteous perish and idols fail those who trust them, but God, who dwells on high, also lives with the crushed and the lowly.
57.sw: Waadilifu wanaangamia na sanamu zinawaangusha wale wanaozitumainia, lakini Mungu, anayekaa juu, pia anakaa pamoja na waliopondeka na wanyonge.
57.am: ጻድቃን ይጠፋሉ፤ ጣዖታትም በእነርሱ የሚታመኑትን ይጥላሉ፤ በከፍታ የሚኖረው እግዚአብሔር ግን ከተሰበሩትና ከትሑታን ጋርም ይኖራል።

58.en: God rejects fasting that is only for show; the fast God chooses is to loose the bonds of injustice, share bread with the hungry and shelter the poor.
58.sw: Mungu anaukataa mfungo wa kujionyesha tu; mfungo ambao Mungu anauchagua ni kufungua vifungo vya udhalimu, kuwagawia wenye njaa mkate na kuwapa maskini mahali pa kukaa.
58.am: እግዚአብሔር ለታይታ ብቻ የሚደረግን ጾም ይጥላል፤ እግዚአብሔር የመረጠው ጾም የግፍን እስራት መፍታት፣ ከተራቡት ጋር እንጀራን መካፈልና ድሆችን ማስጠጋት ነው።

59.en: The people's sins have separated them from God, and they confess them. God puts on righteousness like armor and comes as a Redeemer to Zion.
59.sw: Dhambi za watu zimewatenganisha na Mungu, nao wanaziungama. Mungu anavaa haki kama dirii na kuja Sayuni kama Mkombozi.
59.am: የሕዝቡ ኃጢአት ከእግዚአብሔር ለይቷቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ይናዘዙታል። እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅን እንደ ጥሩር ይለብሳል፤ ወደ ጽዮንም ቤዢ ሆኖ ይመጣል።

60.en: Zion's light has come and the glory of God has risen on her; nations will come to her light, and God will be her everlasting light.
60.sw: Nuru ya Sayuni imekuja na utukufu wa Mungu umemzukia; mataifa yatakuja kwenye nuru yake, na Mungu atakuwa nuru yake ya milele.
60.am: የጽዮን ብርሃን መጥቷል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በእርሷ ላይ ወጥቷል፤ ሕዝቦች ወደ ብርሃኗ ይመጣሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የዘላለም ብርሃኗ ይሆናል።

61.en: The Spirit of God anoints the messenger to bring good news to the poor and to proclaim the year of God's favor. Zion is dressed in garments of salvation.
61.sw: Roho wa Mungu anampaka mafuta mjumbe awapelekee wanyenyekevu habari njema na kutangaza mwaka wa kibali cha Mungu. Sayuni inavikwa mavazi ya wokovu.
61.am: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ መልእክተኛውን ለትሑታን ወንጌልን እንዲያበሥርና የእግዚአብሔርን የሞገስ ዓመት እንዲያውጅ ይቀባዋል። ጽዮን የመዳንን ልብስ ትለብሳለች።

62.en: Zion will receive a new name, and God will rejoice over her as a bridegroom over a bride. The people are to open a road for those coming home.
62.sw: Sayuni itapokea jina jipya, na Mungu atafurahi juu yake kama bwana arusi juu ya bibi arusi wake. Watu wanapaswa kufungua njia kwa ajili ya wale wanaorudi nyumbani.
62.am: ጽዮን አዲስ ስም ትቀበላለች፤ ሙሽራ በሙሽሪቱ ደስ እንደሚለው እግዚአብሔርም በእርሷ ደስ ይለዋል። ሕዝቡ ወደ አገራቸው ለሚመለሱት መንገድ ሊከፍቱ ይገባቸዋል።

63.en: One comes from Edom with garments stained from treading the winepress of judgment. The people remember God's loyal love in the days of Moses and plead for God to return.
63.sw: Mmoja anakuja kutoka Edomu akiwa na mavazi yaliyotiwa madoa kwa kukanyaga shinikizo la hukumu. Watu wanaukumbuka upendo usiokoma wa Mungu katika siku za Musa na kumsihi Mungu arudi.
63.am: አንድ የፍርድን መጥመቂያ በመርገጥ የቆሸሸ ልብስ የለበሰ ከኤዶም ይመጣል። ሕዝቡ በሙሴ ዘመን የነበረውን የእግዚአብሔርን ጽኑ ፍቅር ያስታውሳሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዲመለስ ይማጸናሉ።

64.en: The people ask God to tear open the heavens and come down, confessing that even their righteous deeds are like a soiled cloth. God is their father and they are the clay.
64.sw: Watu wanamwomba Mungu azipasue mbingu na kushuka, wakiungama kwamba hata matendo yao ya haki ni kama kitambaa kilichochafuliwa. Mungu ni Baba yao nao ni udongo.
64.am: ሕዝቡ እግዚአብሔር ሰማያትን ቀድዶ እንዲወርድ ይለምናሉ፤ የጽድቅ ሥራዎቻቸው እንኳ እንደ ቆሸሸ ጨርቅ እንደ ሆኑ ይናዘዛሉ። እግዚአብሔር አባታቸው ነው፤ እነርሱም ጭቃ ናቸው።

65.en: God answers that a rebellious people have been held out to all day long, yet God will spare a faithful remnant. God will create new heavens and a new earth, where the wolf and the lamb will feed together.
65.sw: Mungu anajibu kwamba amewanyooshea mikono watu waasi mchana kutwa, lakini Mungu atawaacha mabaki waaminifu. Mungu ataumba mbingu mpya na nchi mpya, ambapo mbwa mwitu na mwana-kondoo watalisha pamoja.
65.am: እግዚአብሔር ቀኑን ሙሉ ወደ ዓመፀኛ ሕዝብ እጁን እንደ ዘረጋ ይመልሳል፤ ሆኖም እግዚአብሔር ታማኝ ቅሬታን ያድናል። እግዚአብሔር ተኵላና የበግ ጠቦት አብረው የሚሰማሩበትን አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር ይፈጥራል።

66.en: Heaven is God's throne and earth God's footstool, and God looks to the humble. Jerusalem will rejoice like a mother with her children, and all people will come to worship God.
66.sw: Mbingu ni kiti cha enzi cha Mungu na dunia ni kiti cha kuwekea miguu ya Mungu, na Mungu anawaangalia wanyenyekevu. Yerusalemu itafurahi kama mama pamoja na watoto wake, na watu wote watakuja kumwabudu Mungu.
66.am: ሰማይ የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን፣ ምድርም የእግሩ መረገጫ ናት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ትሑታንን ይመለከታል። ኢየሩሳሌም ከልጆቿ ጋር እንዳለች እናት ደስ ይላታል፤ ሰዎችም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ሊሰግዱ ይመጣሉ።
